# Florian Molea

> Florian Molea is a Romanian driving instructor for Categoria B in Bucuresti. The website helps visitors book lessons through WhatsApp, discover long-form YouTube exam-route videos, and find Florian's official social media channels.

## Website Focus

The website is a Romanian presentation website for Florian Molea, Instructor Auto Categoria B. It emphasizes clear driving explanations, calm instruction, real traffic practice in Bucuresti, and an active online community.

The strongest content focus is YouTube, where visitors can watch long videos with complete exam routes, real traffic situations, and calm step-by-step explanations.

The website also includes a premium partnerships page / media kit for brands interested in collaborations with Florian Molea. The media kit presents audience context, social platform statistics, top videos, collaboration formats, prior partnerships, and business contact options.
